scope: All 43 Java classes directly under twilightforest/entity/ai/goal in the pinned FRONTIER snapshot.
methodology: Read class lifecycle methods (especially canUse, canContinueToUse, start, stop, tick) and record derived semantics without copying full source.
design_findings: Goals are small behavioral policies composed by entity priority rather than one monolithic AI controller.
Activation conditions frequently combine semantic state (phase/home/tantrum/tired), physical preconditions (range/ground/LOS), cooldowns and random gates.
Presentation-visible action flags such as breathing, charging, panicked, rampaging and tired are synchronized from authoritative Goal lifecycle.
Complex encounters layer explicit state machines or group controllers on top of the same Goal scheduler.

goals.name: AlwaysWatchTargetGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: target is looked at every tick with wide yaw/pitch limits

goals.name: AttemptToGoHomeGoal
goals.activation_semantics: restriction point exists and mob is outside home area
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: select a random reachable point biased toward home; continue until navigation completes

goals.name: AvoidAnyEntityGoal
goals.activation_semantics: matching entity found in inflated area and a path farther from it can be created
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: navigate away; switch between near/far speed by distance; clear avoided target on stop

goals.name: BreathAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: recent attacker is alive/non-creative, within breath range, visible, and random chance passes
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: set breathing sync flag; track/look at stored eye position; after initial delay damage head-look target until duration/LOS/range ends

goals.name: ChargeAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists in configured distance band, charger is grounded, has LOS, and random frequency passes
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: 15-44 tick windup then navigate to charge point; optional block breaking; apply one attack when in range; clear sprint/charging on stop

goals.name: CubeCenterOnSymbolGoal
goals.activation_semantics: navigation is idle and cube is close to its symbol
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: MoveControl inches toward exact symbol center until sufficiently centered/course invalid

goals.name: CubeMoveToRedstoneSymbolsGoal
goals.activation_semantics: 1/20 random gate and a redstone symbol is found
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: navigate to discovered symbol until navigation completes

goals.name: FlockToSameKindGoal
goals.activation_semantics: 1/40 gate, nearby same-class flock <=5, centroid not already close; pacified bread-holding Kobold excluded
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: move toward flock centroid every 10 ticks; stop when too near/too far or position cleared

goals.name: GhastguardAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and ghast.shouldAttack(target)
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: if target is within 64 blocks squared-range and visible: warn at tick10, fire at tick20, then enter -40 cooldown; synced charging after tick10

goals.name: GhastguardHomedFlightGoal
goals.activation_semantics: ghast is outside home and current wanted movement is absent/invalid-distance
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: one-shot MoveControl command; bias movement toward restriction point when far and directly home when nearer

goals.name: GhastguardRandomFlyGoal
goals.activation_semantics: no target and current wanted movement is absent or too near/far
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: one-shot random MoveControl destination using wander factor

goals.name: GroundAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: cooldown elapsed, target in configured range, attacker grounded; LOS changes random trigger probability
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: set 200-399 tick cooldown and 30-59 tick charge; hold movement/look at target; on expiry slam grounded players in large AABB and knock/damage them

goals.name: HeavySpearAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: UpperGoblinKnight heavy-spear timer is active and living target exists
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: at timer==25 invoke heavy spear impact

goals.name: HoverBaseGoal
goals.activation_semantics: abstract base
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: on start choose a hover position relative to current target

goals.name: HoverBeamGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target alive and Snow Queen phase is BEAM
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: seek hover point, then beam while descending toward beamY; synchronized breathing flag; stop at seek/beam limits or phase/target loss

goals.name: HoverSummonGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target alive, visible, and phase is SUMMON
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: fly between hover positions; when close check/summon minion then select a new hover spot

goals.name: HoverThenDropGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target alive and phase is DROP
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: seek/hover then descend, destroying blocks around boss while dropping; increment successfulDrops when drop duration completes

goals.name: LichAbsorbMinionsGoal
goals.activation_semantics: Lich below half health and owns at least one minion
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: enter scepter timing; after delay consume first owned minion, heal by minion health, create trail/effects, set pop cooldown 40

goals.name: LichMinionsGoal
goals.activation_semantics: Lich phase==2 and not shadow clone
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: equip zombie scepter; periodically spawn minions; strafe with LOS; melee close, alternate bolt/bomb at range, otherwise teleport; governed by attack cooldown

goals.name: LichPopMobsGoal
goals.activation_semantics: non-clone Lich damaged, pop cooldown zero, visible tagged poppable mob nearby
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: after scepter delay consume one visible tagged mob, heal 2, emit effects, set pop cooldown 40

goals.name: LichShadowsGoal
goals.activation_semantics: phase==1, tickCount>20, target exists
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: main Lich synchronizes clone cooldown/invisibility; teleports at cooldown60 and attacks at cooldown0 with clones; clone validates master; stop despawns clones

goals.name: NagaMovementPattern
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and both target/Naga are inside home arena
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: FSM CIRCLE/INTIMIDATE/CRUMBLE/CHARGE/STUNLESS_CHARGE/DAZE controls navigation, charging/dazed flags and terrain crumble; detailed timings in BOSS-AI-MATRIX.json

goals.name: NagaSmashGoal
goals.activation_semantics: horizontal collision and entity griefing allowed
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: one-shot destroy leaves and, under Naga policy, other destroyable blocks around collision box

goals.name: PanicOnFlockDeathGoal
goals.activation_semantics: existing flee timer or dead same-class neighbor within 4x2x4; random flee point available
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: 40 tick panic navigation; Kobold panicked animation flag on start/clear on stop; timer decrements

goals.name: PhantomAttackStartGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and formation ATTACK_PLAYER_START
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: continuously set charge position to target previous position if within home, otherwise restriction point

goals.name: PhantomThrowWeaponGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and formation ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: every 4 formation ticks throw axe or picks depending on knight equipment

goals.name: PhantomUpdateFormationAndMoveGoal
goals.activation_semantics: always active
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: advance formation clock, switch at duration, compute formation destination, command MoveControl at speed 2 when charging else 1; periodically toggles noPhysics

goals.name: PhantomWatchAndAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: look at target; melee on LOS/in-range with 20 tick attack delay; shield guard alternates long guard/cooldown behavior outside weapon-throw stage

goals.name: QuestRamEatWoolGoal
goals.activation_semantics: visible alive tempting item on ground/water within 16 blocks; choose nearest
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: navigate/look at item; within distance squared 6.25 call tryAccept and consume item when accepted

goals.name: RandomLookAroundIfBoredGoal
goals.activation_semantics: no target and 2% random gate
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: look toward random horizontal direction for 20-39 ticks; stop continuing if target appears

goals.name: RedcapBaseGoal
goals.activation_semantics: abstract helper
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: shared Redcap tactical helper layer; concrete light/plant/shy Goals hold activation policy

goals.name: RedcapLightTNTGoal
goals.activation_semantics: griefing allowed, local delay elapsed, block TNT found within 8
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: equip flint, approach TNT, ignite/remove block within 2.4 distance; restore pick and 20 tick delay on stop

goals.name: RedcapPlantTNTGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists within distance squared25, Redcap has TNT, target is not looking, griefing allowed, no lit TNT nearby and no existing TNT within5
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: equip/place one TNT at own position then restore pick

goals.name: RedcapShyGoal
goals.activation_semantics: Redcap shy; target in configured min/max distance and looking at Redcap
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: navigate to circle point around target while maintaining look; continues only while shy, target looking, distance band valid and path active

goals.name: RiderSpearAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: LowerGoblinKnight carries UpperGoblinKnight passenger; target alive; passenger heavy-spear timer active
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: lower rider-side Goal gates behavior to upper knight's spear timing

goals.name: SimplifiedAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and already within melee range
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: attack timer starts at zero; repeatedly checks/executes attack without pathfinding-oriented MeleeAttackGoal machinery

goals.name: ThrowRiderGoal
goals.activation_semantics: mob has no passenger; valid non-boss target; target throw cooldown<=0; parent melee goal can start
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: 10-39 tick hold timer and 80-119 tick chase timeout; when ending with passenger, dismount/throw forward+up; player throw state synchronized with MovePlayerPacket

goals.name: ThrowSpikeBlockGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists within distance squared42, cooldown<=0, attacker alive/LOS and 1/56 random gate
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: set throwing state and 100-199 tick cooldown; continue while chain move length >0

goals.name: UrGhastAttackGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and boss is not in tantrum
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: within 64-block squared-range and LOS: warn tick10, fire tick20, then -40 cooldown; charging sync after tick10

goals.name: UrGhastFlightGoal
goals.activation_semantics: custom flight path can be created and current wanted move is absent/invalid-distance
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: move through path points; when a cycle wraps during trap logic, check/spawn ghasts at traps; set noPhysics false at cruising movement

goals.name: UrGhastLookGoal
goals.activation_semantics: always active
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: without target orient body to velocity; with target inside distance squared4096 orient to target

goals.name: YetiRampageGoal
goals.activation_semantics: target exists and canRampage; internal timeout counts down until <=0
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: set rampaging for configured duration; repeatedly jump, destroy blocks, create falling blocks/targeted hazards and ice bombs; stop resets timeout and enters tired state

goals.name: YetiTiredGoal
goals.activation_semantics: Yeti tired flag set
goals.lifecycle_and_effect: run until tiredDuration; pant every 10 ticks; stop clears tired flag
